proposed_from.topic: Sharp reference-mixture vaccine-waning bounds under changing pathogen variants. Derive the exact joint-history transport compression, sharp reciprocal endpoints, compatible-law certificates, pooled-sign frontier, and whole-set confidence projection; exposure margins are external primitives and case-strain frequencies are not substitutes. The presolve capsule and exact LP kill test are embedded in the queue anchor.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: The kernel is the exact projection of one probability vector that simultaneously indexes both latent period-by-variant exposure histories and history-indexed controlled responses. A linear sensitivity restriction bounds the proportion of noninfected period-one exposees for whom \(R^{[u]}_{2av}\) differs from the no-prior-exposure target response \(R^{[0]}_{2av}\), yielding a nested continuum from no priming at \(\delta=0\) to unrestricted priming at \(\delta=1\). Pointwise in \(\delta\), the projection yields an extended reciprocal image at zero denominators, finite attained endpoints under a separate LP-checkable denominator restriction, and a substantive dual separation theorem that includes the sensitivity inequalities. Perényi and Stensrud (2025, Section 5) inform the point-mass challenge-risk coordinates, but their observed-hazard identification uses stronger exposure-ratio and scaled-new-infection restrictions; equality with their functional is kept as an open boundary rather than a theorem-level comparator promise. The sensitivity-range envelope makes explicit that routine negative tests or serial serology do not identify a small \(\delta\).

seed_details.anchor_opened: The Introduction, Theorem 1, its Appendix B attaining construction, the multiple-exposure-version propositions, and the Discussion were read in the arXiv source for arXiv:2405.01336.
seed_details.question: Can trial strain-specific first-infection risks and external period-by-variant exposure margins be compressed into one exact common-history polytope whose linear-fractional image is the sharp reference-mixture waning set?
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Janvin and Stensrud bound a single representative exposure by interval-risk inclusions; changing variants first alters the projection step because the two period-specific exposure margins must be coupled to one latent variant history before any ratio is optimized.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches pairing reference-mixture challenge effects with joint variant histories, external exposure margins, and sharp linear-fractional bounds located no paper containing all three objects.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Janvin and Stensrud because their sharp interval bounds already allow multiple exposure versions.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their multiple-version results require a stationary version distribution and do not retain external variant margins, latent cross-period variant coupling, or a common-law reference-mixture image.

seed_details.anchor_opened: The abstract, problem formulation, prospective-risk interpretation, and limitations of case-only strain odds ratios were read on the publisher and PubMed pages; the paper explicitly separates infecting-strain composition from exposure composition.
seed_details.question: What finite dual certificate is necessary and sufficient for case-strain frequencies to be harmless substitutes for exposure-variant margins in the sharp waning set?
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The case-only cancellation step must be replaced by a redundancy test for the external-margin rows of the same latent-law fiber.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches combining case-only sieve odds ratios with sharp partial identification under independently measured exposure margins found point-identification results under stronger exposure assumptions, but no redundancy frontier.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Gilbert et al. because the case-only odds ratio cancels exposure frequencies.
seed_details.rebuttal: That cancellation concerns relative strain efficacy under proportional exposure conditions; it does not characterize when replacing exposure margins preserves a two-period common-law waning set.

seed_details.anchor_opened: The Introduction, the temporal-property derivations for leaky and all-or-none vaccines, and the Discussion and reinfection limitation were read in the arXiv source for arXiv:2202.06762.
seed_details.question: What is the smallest policy-mixture perturbation for which one compatible common history reverses the sign of reference-mixture waning?
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Tomer and Biccler's parametric time-variation calculation must first be replaced by a shared-law support problem; separate variantwise extrema do not certify a pooled reversal.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches pairing vaccine variant mixture, sign robustness, and partial-identification radius found temporal decompositions and single-pathogen waning tests but no primal-dual common-law radius.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Tomer and Biccler because changing variant weights mechanically changes pooled effectiveness.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their model demonstrates temporal movement under specified mechanisms; it does not compute the sharp minimum perturbation over one partially identified history law or certify an infinity branch.

seed_details.anchor_opened: The endpoint delta-method inference section and summary-data variance derivations in arXiv:2405.01336 were read together with the paper's Introduction and Discussion.
seed_details.question: Can one projected confidence region uniformly cover the entire nonlinear waning set when trial and exposure samples are independent and active faces or supported histories change?
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Endpointwise smooth transformations must be replaced by simultaneous inversion of feasibility over the primitive trial-risk and exposure-margin region.
seed_details.destination_search: Romano and Shaikh's whole-set coverage, Kaido, Molinari, and Stoye's calibrated projection, and Fang and Santos's directional bootstrap were opened; none specializes their result to reciprocal images of changing-support vaccine-history polytopes.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Romano and Shaikh because their theorem already covers images of identified sets.
seed_details.rebuttal: A usable result must verify their uniform conditions through infeasible fibers, vanishing cells, tied LP faces, and reciprocal denominators, which their general theorem does not do for this model.

seed_details.anchor_opened: The multiple-exposure-version section, especially the stationarity condition and Proposition 2 null implication, was read alongside the Introduction and Discussion in arXiv:2405.01336.
seed_details.question: How do the waning bounds vary with a total-variation departure from stationarity of the exposure-version distribution, and what is the critical departure at which unity enters the set?
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The equality used to cancel early and late version distributions must become a coupling constraint with a total-variation budget.
seed_details.destination_search: No paper was located that combines the challenge-effect stationarity assumption with a closed-form critical sensitivity radius.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from generic contamination neighborhoods because total-variation sensitivity is standard.
seed_details.rebuttal: The nontrivial object is the sharp reciprocal image of a two-period common-history coupling, not a generic widening inequality.

seed_details.anchor_opened: The competing-variant derivations and the Discussion statement that reinfections are excluded and form a natural extension were read in arXiv:2202.06762.
seed_details.question: What sharp reference-mixture waning set remains when reinfection by a second variant is allowed and both ordered infection histories and exposure margins are observed only marginally?
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The absorbing first-infection map must be replaced by an ordered multistate response map, so the history compression is no longer indexed by first infection alone.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for reinfection, variant-specific vaccine waning, and sharp bounds found multistate models but no compatible-law partial-identification result with external exposure margins.
seed_details.red_team: A routine state-space enlargement of the first-infection program.
seed_details.rebuttal: Reinfection destroys the absorbing reduction and changes which cross-period response coordinates are observable, but the resulting dimension makes this less feasible than the selected kernel.

seed_details.anchor_opened: The PMC full text was opened at its Introduction, marked exposure-process setup, weighted estimating equations, asymptotic-distribution result, and concluding discussion.
seed_details.question: Can marked pathogen-count data yield sharp nonparametric bounds for a reference-mixture challenge effect when the proportional-intensity model is relaxed but exposure margins remain known?
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The weighted estimating equation based on a specified marked intensity must be replaced by a finite moment fiber for exposure counts and response types.
seed_details.destination_search: The target-method search found model-based marked-count estimators and sieve analyses, but not sharp external-margin bounds for challenge waning.
seed_details.red_team: A direct robustification of Follmann and Huang's estimating equations.
seed_details.rebuttal: The sharp latent-law problem differs from their log-linear marked-process model, but it lacks the clean two-period theorem of the selected seed.

seed_details.anchor_opened: The arXiv abstract, Introduction, identification theorems, sharp absolute-effect bounds, and Discussion were read for arXiv:2111.11548.
seed_details.question: Which subset of period-by-variant exposure margins is minimally sufficient to attain the full-margin sharp waning set?
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The exposure-cancellation argument must become a row-deletion and dual-essentiality analysis of the history polytope.
seed_details.destination_search: No vaccine paper was found that characterizes the exact value of acquiring selected external exposure-margin coordinates.
seed_details.red_team: A routine sensitivity analysis obtained by dropping LP rows.
seed_details.rebuttal: Row deletion is computationally easy, but an observable necessary-and-sufficient minimal-margin certificate is not supplied by generic LP sensitivity theory.

seed_details.anchor_opened: The Introduction, Theorems 1 through 3 on identification, the efficient-influence-function and asymptotic-linearity theorems, and the causal-interpretation caution were read in the arXiv source for arXiv:2303.11462.
seed_details.question: At exactly which exposure-history restrictions does the sharp partial-identification set collapse to the case-only conditional odds-ratio estimand?
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Their conditional-odds-ratio identification must be embedded as a face of the external-margin compatible-law polytope and the converse established by separating laws.
seed_details.destination_search: No paper was found that gives an if-and-only-if collapse boundary from a two-period variant-history partial-identification model to the case-only point-identified estimand.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from the causal assumptions in van der Laan and Gilbert's Theorem 3.
seed_details.rebuttal: Those assumptions are sufficient for their odds-ratio interpretation; they do not establish necessity relative to the larger history-law class.
